g.text: A local chart on a curved surface
Surface · coordinate curves · tangent plane · normal vector
A patch of z = 0.4(u² − v²). The bold curves are coordinate lines, not geodesics.
The vectors e₁ and e₂ span the tangent plane at p; n is normal to the surface.
